settings.text: Frequently Asked Questions

settings.repere: Texte · What does Oliva Dorado mean?
settings.text: What does Oliva Dorado mean?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Oliva Dorado translates from Spanish to
settings.text: Oliva Dorado translates from Spanish to “Golden Olive.” The name is inspired by the saying, “Olive Oil is the Liquid Gold of the Mediterranean.” This phrase traces back thousands of years to ancient Greece, where olive oil was prized not just as food, but as a symbol of wealth, vitality, and divine favor. Our name pays tribute to that legacy, reflecting the enduring elegance and value of true extra virgin olive oil.

settings.repere: Texte · What makes this olive oil different from
settings.text: What makes this olive oil different from what I can get in stores?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Oliva Dorado is made from early-harvest
settings.text: Oliva Dorado is made from early-harvest olives grown on our single family farm in Spain. The olives are cold-pressed within hours of harvesting and bottled in dark glass to help protect flavor and nutrients. We focus on quality, freshness, and full traceability from harvest to bottle.

settings.repere: Texte · Does it actually taste better?
settings.text: Does it actually taste better?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. Because our olives are harvested ea
settings.text: Yes. Because our olives are harvested early and pressed fresh, the oil has a brighter, more complex flavor. Overall, Oliva Dorado is a lighter olive oil with fruity, buttery notes and a clean, smooth finish. Once you try this kind of fresh, early-harvest extra virgin olive oil, it’s hard to go back to anything else.

settings.repere: Texte · Is it good for cooking or just drizzling
settings.text: Is it good for cooking or just drizzling?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · You can absolutely cook with it. High-qu
settings.text: You can absolutely cook with it. High-quality extra virgin olive oil like ours is a great everyday option. Because it is rich in polyphenols, it may be more stable when used with heat compared to lower-grade oils. It’s ideal for dipping, drizzling, salad dressings, marinades, sautéing, roasting, and even baking.

settings.repere: Texte · How long will it stay fresh?
settings.text: How long will it stay fresh?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our olive oil is best enjoyed within 12
settings.text: Our olive oil is best enjoyed within 12 to 24 months of harvest. To help preserve its freshness, store it in a cool, dark place, away from heat, and always keep the cap tightly closed. We use dark glass bottles to help protect the oil from light and ship quickly after bottling. You’ll always receive oil from the most recent harvest. We’re currently shipping from our 2025-2026 harvest, which was harvested in October 2025.

settings.repere: Texte · Is this is a good gift?
settings.text: Is this is a good gift?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Absolutely. Every bottle of Oliva Dorado
settings.text: Absolutely. Every bottle of Oliva Dorado comes packaged in a custom-designed box with a postcard that shares the story behind the oil and the farm it comes from. It's elegant, thoughtful, and perfect for hosts, food lovers, or anyone who appreciates quality. Whether it’s for a holiday, housewarming, or thank-you gift, it’s a memorable way to share something healthy and special. You can also include a personalized note, which we will handwrite on a second postcard and place inside the box.

settings.repere: Texte · What makes your farm so special?
settings.text: What makes your farm so special?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Oliva Dorado is produced on our organic-
settings.text: Oliva Dorado is produced on our organic-certified farm in the beautiful region of Zaragoza, Spain. It’s a place with a centuries-long tradition of making world-class olive oil. Every step happens on-site, from growing and harvesting the olives to cold-pressing and bottling in glass.

settings.repere: Texte · What are the ingredients?
settings.text: What are the ingredients?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · 100% Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil. Tha
settings.text: 100% Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil. That’s it.

settings.repere: Texte · What is your 90-day risk-free guarantee?
settings.text: What is your 90-day risk-free guarantee?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We want you to love your olive oil. That
settings.text: We want you to love your olive oil. That’s why we offer a 90-day, no questions asked guarantee. If you’re not satisfied for any reason, whether you don’t like the taste or it didn’t meet your expectations, just let us know within 90 days of delivery and we’ll refund your order in full.
